inventionTitles.title: 一种用于人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置
Data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning

section.content: The utility model discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning, in particular to the technical field of the artificial intelligent data acquisition device, which comprises data acquisition equipment, wherein two outer side walls of the data acquisition equipment are fixedly connected with fixed shells, handles are arranged on the outer walls of the two fixed shells, telescopic rods are connected to the inner sides of the bottoms of the two fixed shells in the vertical direction, a connecting plate is fixedly connected between the inner side walls of the bottoms of the two telescopic rods, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the bottom of the center of the connecting plate, a bottom plate is connected to the bottom of the rotating shaft, and wheels are arranged at the positions, close to four corners, of the bottom plate. The utility model has the advantages of small whole volume, light weight, portability, convenient adjustment of the working height of the data acquisition equipment according to the needs in the use process, and convenient movement and adjustment of the working angle of the data acquisition equipment, and is also beneficial to folding when not in use, reduces the occupied space and is convenient.

本实用新型公开了一种用于人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，具体涉及人工智能数据采集装置技术领域，包括数据采集设备，所述数据采集设备的两外侧壁均固定连接有固定壳，两个固定壳的外壁均设置有把手，且两个固定壳的底部内侧均沿竖直方向上连接有伸缩杆，两个伸缩杆的底部内侧壁之间固定连接有连板，所述连板的中心底部固定连接有转动轴，所述转动轴的底部连接有底板，所述底板的底部靠近四个边角位置处均安装有轮子。本实用新型整体体积小、重量轻，易于携带，方便在使用过程中根据需要调节数据采集设备的工作高度，也有利于在不使用时进行折叠，减少占用空间，方便移动和调节数据采集设备的工作角度。

Data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence data acquisition devices, in particular to a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

The term artificial intelligence was originally developed in the Dartmouth society in 1956, since then researchers developed numerous theories and principles, the concept of artificial intelligence was also extended therewith, artificial intelligence, abbreviated as AI, is a branch of computer science, it was attempted to understand the essence of intelligence, and a new intelligent machine capable of reacting in a similar manner to human intelligence was produced, the research in this field includes robots, language recognition, image recognition, natural language processing, expert systems, etc., artificial intelligence has been developed from birth, the theory and technology have been developed gradually, and the application field is expanding, and it is conceivable that technological products brought about by artificial intelligence in the future will be containers of human intelligence. The existing artificial intelligent data acquisition device collects data through workers, then transmits the data to a logic operation mechanism in the artificial intelligent data acquisition device for analysis, so that the learning effect is achieved, an image acquisition storage unit and a sound acquisition unit are arranged in the existing data acquisition device, a camera on the upper portion of the existing data acquisition device shoots things needing to be acquired, then a picture is transferred to the image acquisition storage unit, and sound transmitted from the outside can be transferred to the sound acquisition unit through a recording port on the lower portion of the existing data acquisition device.

The Chinese patent of utility model with publication number of CN214248998U discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, which comprises a base plate and data acquisition equipment, wherein a connecting groove is formed in the center of the top of the base plate, a shift ball is slidably arranged in the connecting groove, a support is fixedly connected to the top of the shift ball, the data acquisition equipment is arranged at the top of the support, and transverse sliding rails are formed in two side walls of the connecting groove. This a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine study can outwards overturn and transversely turn over the seat and indulge and turn over the seat for transversely turn over the seat and indulge and turn over the seat and overturn one hundred eighty degrees to the horizontality, transversely extend the track upwards and communicate with horizontal slide rail this moment, vertically extend the track upwards and communicate with vertical slide rail, thereby make the range of movement of shifting the ball increase one time, accessible movable support drives the shifting ball at horizontal slide rail, transversely extend the track, vertical slide rail and vertically extend the track internal movement this moment, thereby make the shooting direction of data acquisition equipment have the multidirectionality.

The above patent discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, for the above patent that has been disclosed, we can call the prior art, and specific structure has been fully disclosed, i.e. the prior art belongs to very clear, accurate and objective existence, for the above patent, i.e. the prior art, the known data acquisition device is used for artificial intelligence machine learning, therefore, the utility model improves the data acquisition device based on artificial intelligence machine learning, in the above patent, the actual structural design can reach the expected technical effect, but in actual use, there still exist some disadvantages, such as the design of the base plate at the bottom of the above patent makes the whole volume of the device big, heavy weight, inconvenient to carry, inconvenient to adjust the working height of data acquisition equipment according to the needs in the use, and unable to fold when not using, make occupation space great, convenient to remove and adjust the working angle of data acquisition equipment.

Disclosure of Invention

The technical scheme of the utility model aims at the technical problem that the prior art is too single, provides a solution which is obviously different from the prior art, and provides a data acquisition device for artificial intelligent machine learning in order to overcome the defects of the prior art.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the present utility model provides the following technical solutions: the utility model provides a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine study, includes data acquisition equipment, the equal fixedly connected with fixed shell of two lateral walls of data acquisition equipment, the outer wall of two fixed shells all is provided with the handle, and the bottom inboard of two fixed shells all is connected with the telescopic link along vertical direction, fixedly connected with even board between the bottom inside wall of two telescopic links, the center bottom fixedly connected with axis of rotation of even board, the bottom of axis of rotation is connected with the bottom plate, the bottom of bottom plate is close to four corner positions department and all installs the wheel, the lateral wall of telescopic link all is provided with the insection along vertical direction, the bottom outer wall of fixed shell is provided with and is used for the spacing locking mechanism to the telescopic link.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, the fixed shell is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the data acquisition equipment through a screw, and the handle is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the fixed shell through hot melt adhesive or a screw.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, a shrinkage groove is arranged in the fixing shell along the vertical direction corresponding to the outer part of the telescopic rod.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, a bearing seat is arranged at the top of the bottom plate at the position corresponding to the end part of the rotating shaft, and a rubber pad is arranged at the top of the connecting plate.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, the locking mechanism comprises a clamping plate which is inserted into the outer wall of the bottom of the fixed shell along the horizontal direction, one end part of the clamping plate is provided with gear shaping teeth which are matched and clamped with the gear patterns, the other end of the clamping plate is positioned outside the fixed shell and is fixedly connected with a poking plate, and a spring is connected between the inner side wall of the poking plate and the outer wall of the fixed shell.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, the outer wall of the fixing shell is provided with a through hole for inserting the clamping plate, and the length and width of the vertical section of the through hole are respectively larger than those of the clamping plate.

As a further improvement of the technical scheme of the utility model, the two ends of the spring are welded with metal sheets, and the two metal sheets are fixedly connected with the outer wall of the fixed shell and the inner side wall of the poking plate through screws.

The utility model has the beneficial effects that:

compared with the prior art, the telescopic device is small in whole size, light in weight and easy to carry, two fixing shells are symmetrically arranged on two outer walls of the data acquisition device, the telescopic rod capable of being adjusted in a telescopic mode is arranged in the fixing shells, and the locking mechanism is arranged, when the extending length of the telescopic rod is adjusted, the poking plate is pulled outwards to drive the gear shaping at the end portion of the clamping plate to be separated from the insection, at the moment, the spring stretches, the telescopic rod is not limited to be capable of adjusting the extending length, after the poking plate is loosened after the extending length is adjusted to the required extending length, the spring resets to drive the clamping plate to move inwards, the gear shaping is clamped on the insection to complete locking limiting, the working height of the data acquisition device is conveniently adjusted according to the requirement in the use process, folding is facilitated, occupied space is reduced, the telescopic rod is convenient to carry, meanwhile, the set rotating shaft can be rotated at the top of the bottom plate to conveniently adjust the working angle of the data acquisition device according to the requirement in use.

The reference numerals are: 1. a data acquisition device; 2. a fixed case; 3. a handle; 4. a telescopic rod; 5. a connecting plate; 6. a rotating shaft; 7. a bearing seat; 8. a bottom plate; 9. a wheel; 10. a rubber pad; 11. tooth patterns; 12. a shrink tank; 13. a clamping plate; 14. gear shaping; 15. a toggle plate; 16. a spring; 17. and a through hole.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present utility model will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present utility model, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the utility model without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the utility model.

The utility model provides a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine study, including data acquisition equipment 1, the equal fixedly connected with fixed shell 2 of two lateral walls of data acquisition equipment 1, the outer wall of two fixed shells 2 all is provided with handle 3, and the bottom inboard of two fixed shells 2 all is connected with telescopic link 4 along vertical direction, fixedly connected with link plate 5 between the bottom inside wall of two telescopic links 4, the center bottom fixedly connected with axis of rotation 6 of link plate 5, the bottom of axis of rotation 6 is connected with bottom plate 8, wheel 9 is all installed to the bottom of bottom plate 8 near four corner positions department, all with be provided with insection 11 along vertical direction in the lateral wall of telescopic link 4, the bottom outer wall of fixed shell 2 is provided with the locking mechanism that is used for spacing telescopic link 4.

As shown in fig. 2, the inside of the fixed shell 2 is provided with a shrinkage groove 12 corresponding to the outside of the telescopic rod 4 along the vertical direction, so that the telescopic rod 4 is convenient to stretch out and draw back in the inside of the fixed shell 2, and the use height of the data acquisition equipment 1 is conveniently adjusted by adjusting the stretching length of the telescopic rod 4 when in use.

As shown in fig. 1, a bearing seat 7 is arranged at the top of the bottom plate 8 corresponding to the end position of the rotating shaft 6, a rubber pad 10 is arranged at the top of the connecting plate 5, and the rubber pad 10 can avoid collision between the bottom plate 8 and the bottom of the data acquisition device 1 when the connecting plate is folded and retracted.

As shown in fig. 1-4, the locking mechanism comprises a clamping plate 13 which is inserted into the outer wall of the bottom of the fixed shell 2 along the horizontal direction, a gear shaping 14 which is clamped with the gear pattern 11 in a matching way is arranged at one end of the clamping plate 13, a stirring plate 15 is fixedly connected with the other end of the clamping plate 13 outside the fixed shell 2, a spring 16 is connected between the inner side wall of the stirring plate 15 and the outer wall of the fixed shell 2, and the arranged locking mechanism is convenient to lock and limit after the extending length of the telescopic rod 4 is adjusted in the use process.

Working principle: the utility model designs a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, the specific structure is shown in the accompanying drawings 1-4 of the specification, in the technical scheme, two fixing shells 2 are symmetrically arranged on two outer walls of data acquisition equipment 1, a telescopic rod 4 capable of being adjusted in a telescopic mode is arranged in the fixing shells 2, and a locking mechanism is arranged, when the extension length of the telescopic rod 4 is adjusted, firstly, a poking plate 15 is pulled outwards to drive a gear shaping 14 at the end part of a clamping plate 13 to be separated from a tooth pattern 11, at the moment, a spring 16 stretches, the telescopic rod 4 is not limited to be capable of adjusting the extension length, after the extension length is adjusted to a required extension length, the poking plate 15 is loosened, the spring 16 resets to drive the clamping plate 13 to move inwards, the gear shaping 14 is clamped on the tooth pattern 11 to complete locking limiting, the working height of the data acquisition equipment 1 is conveniently adjusted according to the requirement in the use process, the occupied space is reduced, and the telescopic rod 4 is conveniently stretched out when the extension length of the telescopic rod 4 is adjusted, at the bottom part is conveniently carried, at the same time, the rotating shaft 6 arranged at the bottom part is conveniently stretched when the data acquisition equipment 1 is at a certain height, the top of the rotating angle of the rotating equipment 1 can be conveniently adjusted according to the requirement when the data acquisition equipment is used, and the data acquisition equipment can be conveniently adjusted according to the requirement when the rotation angle is required at the top 8.

In the drawings of the disclosed embodiments, only the structures related to the embodiments of the present disclosure are referred to, and other structures can refer to the common design, so that the same embodiment and different embodiments of the present disclosure can be combined with each other without conflict;

finally: the foregoing description of the preferred embodiments of the utility model is not intended to limit the utility model to the precise form disclosed, and any such modifications, equivalents, and alternatives falling within the spirit and principles of the utility model are intended to be included within the scope of the utility model.
